subtopic: Primary and secondary sequence databases, data retrieval and formats
key_concepts: GenBank, EMBL-EBI, DDBJ, RefSeq archival and curated databases
UniProtKB architecture (Swiss-Prot curated vs TrEMBL unreviewed)
Sequence file formats (FASTA, GenBank, EMBL, GFF3) and accession schema
Pattern and motif databases (PROSITE, PRINTS, Pfam, SMART, InterPro)

subtopic: Pairwise sequence alignment and dynamic programming algorithms
key_concepts: Needleman-Wunsch algorithm for global alignment and traceback matrix
Smith-Waterman algorithm for local alignment and zero-reset condition
Scoring matrices: PAM (Markov model) vs BLOSUM (observed blocks $s(i,j) = \frac{1}{\lambda}\ln\frac{q_{ij}}{p_i p_j}$)
Affine gap penalty models: gap opening penalty $\gamma$ and gap extension penalty $\sigma$

subtopic: Heuristic database searching and statistical significance (BLAST & FASTA)
key_concepts: BLAST heuristic lookup: word size $W$, threshold $T$, two-hit seed extension
BLAST programs: blastn, blastp, blastx, tblastn, tblastx, PSI-BLAST
Statistical parameters: Raw score $S$, Bit score $S' = \frac{\lambda S - \ln K}{\ln 2}$, E-value ($E = K m n e^{-\lambda S}$)
FASTA algorithm: hashing, ktup size, diagonal optimization, band Smith-Waterman

subtopic: Multiple sequence alignment (MSA) and profile hidden Markov models
key_concepts: Progressive alignment methods (ClustalW, Clustal Omega) and guide tree heuristics
Iterative alignment algorithms (MUSCLE, MAFFT) and consistency scoring (T-Coffee)
Profile Hidden Markov Models (profile HMMs: match, insert, delete states, HMMER)
Identification of conserved catalytic residues, sequence logos, and information content

subtopic: Molecular phylogenetics, tree topology and reconstruction methods
key_concepts: Phylogenetic tree types: rooted vs unrooted, cladograms, phylograms, ultrametric trees
Distance-based tree construction: UPGMA (constant rate assumption) vs Neighbor-Joining
Character-based tree construction: Maximum Parsimony (Fitch/Sankoff) and Maximum Likelihood
Statistical tree assessment: Bootstrap resampling ($FBP$), jackknife, consensus trees

subtopic: Comparative genomics, gene orthology and evolutionary selection
key_concepts: Distinction among orthologs, in-paralogs, out-paralogs, and xenologs
Synteny mapping, microsynteny conservation, and whole-genome duplication (WGD)
Horizontal gene transfer (HGT) detection via atypical GC content and codon usage bias
Selection pressure metrics: nonsynonymous to synonymous substitution ratio $d_N/d_S$ ($\omega$)

subtopic: Genome annotation, variant effect prediction and functional networks
key_concepts: Ab initio prokaryotic (Glimmer) and eukaryotic (GENSCAN, AUGUSTUS) gene finders
Gene Ontology (GO) functional hierarchies: Biological Process, Molecular Function, Cellular Component
In silico variant effect prediction: SIFT, PolyPhen-2, CADD scores for missense mutations
Transposable elements and repetitive sequence annotation using RepeatMasker

subtopic: Protein secondary and tertiary structure prediction and validation
key_concepts: Secondary structure prediction: Chou-Fasman propensity, GOR information theory, neural nets (PSIPRED)
Comparative/homology modeling steps: template selection, alignment, coordinate transfer, loop modeling
Fold recognition, protein threading, and ab initio fragment assembly (Rosetta)
Stereochemical quality validation: Ramachandran plot criteria (PROCHECK), QMEAN, Verify3D

subtopic: AI-based structural biology and AlphaFold models
key_concepts: AlphaFold2 architecture: Evoformer multi-track representation and Invariant Point Attention (IPA)
Confidence metrics: predicted Local Distance Difference Test (pLDDT) and Predicted Aligned Error (PAE)
AlphaFold-Multimer for protein-protein complex interfaces and stoichoimetric modeling
Structural bioinformatics applications: intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) vs globular domains

subtopic: Molecular mechanics, force fields and potential energy surfaces
key_concepts: Classical force field empirical functions: bond stretching, angle bending, dihedral torsions
Non-bonded potentials: Lennard-Jones 12-6 dispersion-repulsion and Coulombic electrostatics
Standard biomolecular force fields: AMBER, CHARMM, OPLS-AA, GROMOS parameters
Energy minimization algorithms: Steepest Descent, Conjugate Gradient, Newton-Raphson

subtopic: Molecular dynamics simulations and conformational trajectory analysis
key_concepts: Numerical integration of Newton's equations: Verlet, Velocity Verlet, Leapfrog algorithms
Thermostats and barostats in $NVT$ and $NPT$ thermodynamic ensembles (Nosé-Hoover, Parrinello-Rahman)
Structural trajectory metrics: RMSD, RMSF, radius of gyration ($R_g$), solvent accessible surface area (SASA)
Free energy landscapes, essential dynamics via Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

subtopic: Chemoinformatics, molecular docking, QSAR and in silico ADMET
key_concepts: Chemical representation formats (SMILES, InChI, SDF) and structural fingerprint searching
Structure-based drug design: rigid/flexible receptor-ligand docking, scoring functions, binding $\Delta G$
Ligand-based drug design: Pharmacophore hypothesis generation, 2D/3D QSAR, Hansch equation
Lipinski's Rule of 5, Veber's criteria, and in silico ADMET and toxicity filtering (PAINS)

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Applied mathematics, differential equations and transport modeling in bioprocesses
key_concepts: Ordinary differential equations (ODEs) for microbial growth, substrate decay, and product accumulation
Transport phenomena analogies: momentum transfer (viscosity), heat transfer (conduction), mass transfer (diffusion)
Dimensionless numbers: Reynolds ($Re$), Schmidt ($Sc$), Sherwood ($Sh$), Peclet ($Pe$)
Mass transfer equipment principles: packed columns, bubble columns, airlift loop bioreactors

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Macroscopic material and energy balances in bioreactor systems
key_concepts: Steady-state and unsteady-state material balances with metabolic generation/consumption terms
Degrees of reduction ($\gamma$) of carbon substrates and theoretical biomass yields
Respiratory Quotient ($RQ = \text{moles CO}_2 / \text{moles O}_2$) and carbon balance verification
Bioreactor heat balances: metabolic heat release ($Q_{gr} = \frac{\Delta H_c}{Y_{X/O_2}} \mu X V$) and cooling duty

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Non-equilibrium thermodynamics of biological systems and metabolic oscillations
key_concepts: Biological cells as open, non-equilibrium dissipative thermodynamic structures
Thermodynamic forces ($X_k$) and conjugate fluxes ($J_k$), linear phenomenological equations
Onsager reciprocal relations ($L_{ij} = L_{ji}$) and rate of entropy production ($\sigma \ge 0$)
Thermodynamic efficiency of oxidative phosphorylation and limit-cycle glycolytic oscillations

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Microbial growth kinetics, substrate inhibition and maintenance models
key_concepts: Monod growth kinetics: specific growth rate $\mu = \mu_{\max} \frac{S}{K_s + S}$ and saturation constant $K_s$
Substrate inhibition kinetics: Haldane/Andrews equation ($\mu = \frac{\mu_{\max} S}{K_s + S + S^2/K_i}$)
Competitive, non-competitive, and uncompetitive end-product inhibition models
Maintenance energy coefficient $m_s$ and Pirt equation ($\frac{1}{Y_{X/S}} = \frac{1}{Y_{X/S}^{\max}} + \frac{m_s}{\mu}$)

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Bioreactor operation modes: batch, fed-batch, chemostat and continuous culture
key_concepts: Batch culture growth kinetics: lag, exponential, deceleration phases, doubling time ($t_d = \frac{\ln 2}{\mu}$)
Fed-batch cultures: quasi-steady state, constant feed, exponential feeding for constant $\mu$
Continuous stirred-tank reactor (chemostat): dilution rate $D = F/V$, steady-state $\bar{S}$ and $\bar{X}$
Critical dilution rate ($D_{crit}$) and culture washout condition ($D \ge \mu_{\max}$)

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Oxygen mass transfer, dissolved oxygen dynamics and $k_L a$ determination
key_concepts: Two-film theory, Oxygen Transfer Rate ($OTR = k_L a (C^* - C_L)$) and Oxygen Uptake Rate ($OUR = q_{O_2} X$)
Experimental $k_L a$ measurement: dynamic gassing-out, sodium sulfite oxidation, oxygen exhaust gas balance
Critical dissolved oxygen concentration ($C_{crit}$) and oxygen transfer limitation regimes
Factors governing $k_L a$: gas flow rate, superficial gas velocity ($v_s$), impeller speed ($N$), antifoams

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Bioreactor fluid rheology, aeration, agitation and power consumption
key_concepts: Rheological models of fermentation broths: Newtonian, pseudoplastic (power law), Bingham plastic, Casson
Power number ($N_p = \frac{P}{\rho N^3 D_i^5}$) and impeller Reynolds number ($Re_i = \frac{\rho N D_i^2}{\mu}$)
Gassed vs ungassed power draw: Michel-Miller correlation ($P_g = C (P_0^2 N D_i^3 / Q^{0.56})^{0.45}$)
Hydrodynamic shear and impeller geometries: Rushton radial turbine, pitched-blade axial turbine, marine propeller

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Thermal sterilization kinetics and air filtration systems
key_concepts: Thermal destruction kinetics of bacterial endospores: decimal reduction time ($D$-value) and thermal resistance ($z$-value)
Sterilization Del factor ($\nabla = \ln(N_0/N_t) = \int k(T) \, dt$) and thermal death profile
Batch vs continuous high-temperature short-time (HTST) sterilization and nutrient preservation
Sterile air supply: depth filtration mechanisms (inertial impaction, interception, diffusion) and membrane cartridges

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Enzyme immobilization techniques and heterogeneous reaction kinetics
key_concepts: Immobilization chemistries: covalent attachment (glutaraldehyde), physical adsorption, entrapment (alginate, polyacrylamide)
External mass transfer boundary layer resistance and observable Damköhler number ($Da$)
Internal intraparticle diffusion in porous biocatalysts: Thiele modulus ($\Phi = R \sqrt{V_{\max} / (K_m D_{eff})}$)
Internal effectiveness factor ($\eta$) and observed kinetics of immobilized enzyme reactors (packed bed, fluidized bed)

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Biocatalysis in non-aqueous media and rational protein engineering
key_concepts: Enzymatic catalysis in organic solvents, supercritical $CO_2$, and ionic liquids
Role of hydration in non-aqueous enzymology: essential water layer, thermodynamic water activity ($a_w$), solvent $\log P$
Rational enzyme engineering: active site remodeling, catalytic triad repositioning, disulfide bond stabilization
Directed evolution strategies: error-prone PCR, DNA shuffling, staggered extension process (StEP), screening assays

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Industrial fermentations: organic acids, antibiotics, enzymes and biopolymers
key_concepts: Citric acid fermentation by *Aspergillus niger*: regulation by trace metals ($Fe^{2+}, Mn^{2+}$), glycolysis overflow
Penicillin production by *Penicillium chrysogenum*: precursors, side-chain feeding, catabolite repression
Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA/PHB) biosynthesis under nutrient limitation and high carbon-to-nitrogen ratios
Industrial microbial enzyme production: alkaline proteases, $\alpha$-amylases, cellulases, lipases

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Downstream processing: cell disruption and solid-liquid separation
key_concepts: Solid-liquid separation: Rotary Vacuum Drum Filtration (RVDF), disc-stack and tubular bowl centrifuges (Stokes' law, $\Sigma$ concept)
Mechanical cell disruption: high-pressure homogenizers, bead mills, and protein release kinetics ($R = R_m [1 - \exp(-k N P^a)]$)
Non-mechanical cell lysis: osmotic shock, enzymatic lysis (lysozyme), detergent permeabilization
Flocculation, coagulation, and isoelectric precipitation of crude cellular debris

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Downstream processing: extraction, membrane filtration and chromatography
key_concepts: Aqueous two-phase extraction (ATPE: PEG-salt, PEG-dextran) and partition coefficient ($K = C_{top}/C_{bottom}$)
Supercritical fluid extraction (SFE) with $CO_2$: critical temperature, pressure, and polarity modifiers
Cross-flow membrane filtration: microfiltration (MF), ultrafiltration (UF), concentration polarization, fouling resistance
Preparative chromatography: expanded bed adsorption (EBA), simulated moving bed (SMB), ion exchange, hydrophobic interaction

syllabus_unit: Unit 12: Biochemical Engineering and Industrial Biotechnology
subtopic: Bioprocess scale-up, facility design and metabolic pathway engineering
key_concepts: Bioreactor scale-up criteria: constant volumetric mass transfer ($k_L a$), constant power per unit volume ($P/V$), constant tip speed
Facility flowsheeting, clean-in-place (CIP), steam-in-place (SIP), aseptic validation
Techno-economic analysis of bioprocesses: CapEx, OpEx, product yield vs volumetric productivity trade-offs
Metabolic engineering: Flux Balance Analysis (FBA), stoichiometric matrices, cofactor balancing, synthetic gene circuits

subtopic: Recombinant DNA tools, expression vectors and modern assembly methods
key_concepts: Modern molecular cloning: Gibson assembly, Golden Gate cloning (Type IIS enzymes), Ligation-Independent Cloning (LIC)
Recombinant expression systems: prokaryotic (T7 system) vs eukaryotic (Pichia pastoris AOX1, CHO cell lines)
Epitope and affinity tags: 6xHis, GST, MBP, FLAG; cleavage mechanisms (TEV protease, enterokinase)
Site-directed mutagenesis: QuikChange protocol, overlap extension PCR, alanine scanning mutagenesis

subtopic: Precision genome editing technologies (CRISPR-Cas, ZFNs, TALENs)
key_concepts: Engineered nucleases: Zinc Finger Nucleases (ZFNs) and TALENs (repeat variable di-residue RVD code)
CRISPR-Cas systems: Cas9 (5'-NGG-3' PAM, blunt double-strand break) vs Cas12a/Cpf1 (5'-TTTV-3' PAM, staggered ends)
Repair pathways: Non-Homologous End Joining (NHEJ, indels) vs Homology-Directed Repair (HDR, precise integration)
Next-gen editing tools: Cytosine and Adenine Base Editors (CBE/ABE), Prime Editing (pegRNA, reverse transcriptase)

subtopic: Next-generation sequencing and high-throughput functional genomics
key_concepts: Sequencing technologies: Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis, PacBio Single Molecule Real-Time (SMRT), Oxford Nanopore
RNA-Seq methodology: cDNA library prep, rRNA depletion, read mapping, quantification (TPM, FPKM), differential expression
Epigenomic mapping: ChIP-Seq, ATAC-Seq (transposase accessible chromatin), CUT&RUN, bisulfite sequencing
Whole genome de novo assembly algorithms: Overlap-Layout-Consensus (OLC) vs de Bruijn graphs ($k$-mers)

subtopic: Advanced vaccinology, mRNA vaccines and molecular diagnostics
key_concepts: Vaccine platforms: live-attenuated, killed, recombinant subunit, virus-like particles (VLPs), DNA and mRNA vaccines
mRNA vaccine engineering: in vitro transcription, 5' capping, pseudouridine ($\Psi$) incorporation, lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery
Adjuvants: alum, MF59, AS01, CpG oligonucleotides; mechanisms of pattern recognition receptor (PRR) stimulation
Molecular diagnostic assays: quantitative RT-qPCR (TaqMan vs SYBR Green), digital droplet PCR (ddPCR), LAMP

subtopic: Therapeutic antibodies, phage display and CAR-T cell immunotherapy
key_concepts: Monoclonal antibody production: hybridoma technology, humanization of murine CDRs, fully human transgenic mouse platforms
In vitro display systems: filamentous phage display (M13 pIII fusion libraries), yeast display, ribosome display
Engineered antibody modalities: single-chain Fv (scFv), bispecific T-cell engagers (BiTEs), antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs)
Cellular immunotherapy: Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T-cell architecture, costimulatory domains (CD28, 4-1BB), immune checkpoint inhibitors

subtopic: Stem cell technology, iPSCs and 3D organoid disease models
key_concepts: Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs): Yamanaka reprogramming factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) and pluripotency markers
Guided directed differentiation protocols using developmental morphogens (Wnt, BMP, FGF, retinoic acid)
3D self-organizing organoids: cerebral, intestinal, hepatic, and renal organoids in extracellular matrix (Matrigel)
Organoid applications in patient-derived disease modeling, host-pathogen interactions, and high-throughput drug screening

subtopic: Tissue engineering, biomaterials and diagnostic biosensors
key_concepts: Biomaterial scaffolds: natural (collagen, alginate, hyaluronic acid) and synthetic (PLA, PGA, PLGA) polymers
Scaffold porosity, mechanical stiffness, biodegradation rates, and dynamic perfusion bioreactors
3D Bioprinting modalities: extrusion, droplet-based, laser-assisted printing; bioink formulation
Biosensor architectures: biological sensing elements (enzymes, aptamers), transducers (electrochemical, optical SPR, FET)

subtopic: Animal transgenesis, cloning (SCNT) and germplasm conservation
key_concepts: Animal transgenesis methods: pronuclear microinjection, retroviral transduction, embryonic stem cell homologous recombination
Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer (SCNT): enucleation, electrofusion, artificial oocyte activation, epigenetic reprogramming barriers
Animal cloning applications: therapeutic recombinant protein production in milk (pharming), disease models
Cryobanking and germplasm preservation: gamete, embryo, and somatic cell vitrification protocols

subtopic: Marker-assisted plant breeding and agricultural genomics
key_concepts: Molecular marker systems: RFLP, RAPD, AFLP, SSR, SNP genotyping (KASP, high-density arrays, GBS)
Linkage disequilibrium (LD) mapping and Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS) in crop species
Marker-Assisted Selection (MAS): foreground selection for target alleles and background selection for recurrent parent genome
Marker-Assisted Backcrossing (MABC), gene pyramiding for multiple disease resistances, genomic selection (GS) models

subtopic: Plant genetic transformation, trait engineering and molecular farming
key_concepts: *Agrobacterium tumefaciens* T-DNA transfer mechanism: vir gene cascade, T-strand escort, nuclear targeting, random integration
Direct gene transfer methods: biolistic particle gun, protoplast electroporation, PEG-mediated uptake
Transgenic crop traits: insect resistance (Bt $\delta$-endotoxins Cry proteins), herbicide resistance (glyphosate EPSPS, glufosinate PAT)
Plastid transformation (transplastomics): maternal inheritance, high expression levels, absence of epigenetic silencing

subtopic: Plant cell culture, in vitro organogenesis and secondary metabolites
key_concepts: Cellular totipotency, dedifferentiation, and callus induction; organogenesis control via auxin:cytokinin ratio
Somatic embryogenesis and artificial seed (synseed) production via calcium alginate encapsulation
Haploid and doubled-haploid technology: anther/microspore culture, chromosome doubling via colchicine
Somaclonal variation and suspension culture elicitation of secondary metabolites in plant bioreactors

subtopic: Marine biotechnology, marine pharmacology and marine biofilm ecology
key_concepts: Marine biodiversity and extremophile physiological adaptations: piezophiles, psychrophiles, halophiles
Marine natural products and pharmacology: ziconotide ($ω$-conotoxin), trabectedin (ET-743), bryostatins, cytarabine
Marine biofouling: primary conditioning film, bacterial biofilm settlement, macro-fouling invertebrates
Environment-friendly marine antifouling compounds and marine microbial enzymes (agarases, carrageenases)

subtopic: Environmental biotechnology: biological wastewater treatment and nutrient removal
key_concepts: Wastewater quality indicators: Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD), Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD), TOC, TSS
Suspended growth systems: Activated Sludge Process (ASP), F/M ratio, mean cell residence time ($\theta_c$), sludge volume index (SVI)
Attached growth systems: trickling filters, rotating biological contactors (RBC), moving bed biofilm reactors (MBBR)
Biological Nutrient Removal (BNR): nitrification-denitrification sequence and anaerobic ammonium oxidation (Anammox)

subtopic: Bioremediation, phytoremediation and bioenergy circular economy
key_concepts: Bioremediation strategies: in situ (bioventing, biosparging, bioaugmentation) vs ex situ (biopiles, windrows)
Microbial degradation pathways of recalcitrant xenobiotics (PAHs, polychlorinated biphenyls, organophosphates)
Phytoremediation mechanisms: phytoextraction, phytostabilization, rhizofiltration, hyperaccumulator plants
Bioenergy generation: cellulosic ethanol, microalgae biodiesel, biogas production, Microbial Fuel Cells (MFC)

subtopic: Bacterial growth kinetics and mathematical modeling of population growth
key_concepts: Phases of bacterial batch growth curve: lag, exponential, deceleration, stationary, and decline phases
Kinetic equations: specific growth rate $\mu = \frac{\ln(X_2/X_1)}{t_2 - t_1}$, generation/doubling time $g = \frac{\ln 2}{\mu}$
Diauxic growth kinetics, carbon catabolite repression (CCR), and cAMP-CRP regulatory circuitry
Measurement of bacterial growth: direct cell counts, viable CFU plating, spectrophotometric optical density (OD600)

subtopic: Bacterial cell division machinery, divisome assembly and spatial regulation
key_concepts: Tubulin homolog FtsZ GTPase polymerization, protofilaments, and Z-ring constriction forces
Divisome core components: FtsA, ZipA membrane tethers, FtsQ, FtsL, FtsB, and peptidoglycan synthase FtsI/PBP3
Spatial positioning by the MinCDE oscillation system: pole-to-pole dynamics inhibiting FtsZ at cell poles
Nucleoid occlusion mechanism: SlmA (in *E. coli*) and Noc (in *B. subtilis*) preventing division over unsegregated chromosomes

subtopic: Bacterial stress responses and stringent control
key_concepts: The stringent response: uncharged tRNA sensing, RelA/SpoT synthase activity, alarmone (p)ppGpp synthesis
Transcriptional reprogramming by (p)ppGpp and DksA: downregulation of rRNA/tRNA vs activation of amino acid biosynthesis
Alternative sigma factors: $\sigma^S$ (RpoS) general stress response, $\sigma^{32}$ (RpoH) heat shock response, $\sigma^E$ envelope stress
Bacterial SOS response: RecA filamentation on ssDNA, LexA repressor autocleavage, activation of error-prone polymerases

subtopic: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR): enzymatic inactivation and drug breakdown
key_concepts: $\beta$-lactamases: Class A (penicillinases), Class B (metallo-$\beta$-lactamases, NDM-1), Class C (AmpC), Class D (OXA)
Extended-Spectrum $\beta$-Lactamases (ESBLs) and carbapenemases conferring resistance to third-generation cephalosporins
Aminoglycoside-modifying enzymes: acetyltransferases (AAC), phosphotransferases (APH), nucleotidyltransferases (ANT)
Enzymatic chloramphenicol resistance via chloramphenicol acetyltransferase (CAT) and macrolide esterases

subtopic: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR): target alteration and protection mechanisms
key_concepts: Methicillin resistance in *Staphylococcus aureus* (MRSA): mecA gene encoding low-affinity PBP2a
Vancomycin resistance in enterococci (VRE): vanA operon substituting D-Ala-D-Ala with D-Ala-D-Lac in cell wall
Fluoroquinolone resistance via DNA gyrase (gyrA) and topoisomerase IV (parC) quinolone resistance-determining regions (QRDR)
Macrolide and linezolid resistance through 23S rRNA methylation by Erm methyltransferases

subtopic: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR): multidrug efflux pumps and membrane permeability
key_concepts: Major classes of bacterial efflux systems: RND, MFS, ABC, SMR, and MATE transporters
Resistance-Nodulation-Division (RND) tripartite complexes: AcrAB-TolC (*E. coli*) and MexAB-OprM (*P. aeruginosa*)
Outer membrane permeability alterations: porin loss (OmpF, OmpC mutations) restricting antibiotic penetration
Bacterial persistence vs resistance: metabolic dormancy, toxin-antitoxin systems (HipA/HipB), biofilm barrier tolerance

subtopic: Bacterial cell wall biosynthesis and target pathways of antibiotics
key_concepts: Cytoplasmic stage of peptidoglycan synthesis: UDP-MurNAc-pentapeptide assembly and Fosfomycin/D-cycloserine targets
Membrane stage: Lipid I and Lipid II biosynthesis via MraY and MurG, bactoprenol carrier flipping and Bacitracin inhibition
Periplasmic transglycosylation and transpeptidation: high-molecular-weight PBPs and penicillin inhibition mechanism
Gram-negative outer membrane LPS biogenesis (Lpt system) and Polymyxin/Colistin disruption mechanisms

subtopic: Programmed cell death: intrinsic and extrinsic apoptotic pathways
key_concepts: Intrinsic (mitochondrial) pathway: Bax/Bak oligomerization, MOMP, cytochrome c release, Apaf-1 apoptosome assembly
Extrinsic (death receptor) pathway: FasL/TNF-$\alpha$ binding, FADD recruitment, DISC complex, caspase-8 activation
Bcl-2 superfamily balance: anti-apoptotic (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1) vs pro-apoptotic BH3-only proteins (Bid, Bim, Puma)
Executioner caspases (caspase-3, -6, -7) cleavage of ICAD, PARP, lamin, causing DNA fragmentation and apoptotic bodies

subtopic: Regulated non-apoptotic cell death: necroptosis, pyroptosis and ferroptosis
key_concepts: Necroptosis pathway: RIPK1 and RIPK3 kinase activation, necrosome formation, MLKL phosphorylation and membrane pore lysis
Pyroptosis pathway: canonical (caspase-1) and non-canonical (caspase-4/5/11) activation, Gasdermin-D (GSDMD) cleavage and IL-1$\beta$ release
Ferroptosis mechanism: iron-dependent lipid peroxidation, System $X_c^-$ cystine/glutamate antiporter, GPX4 inactivation
Morphological and biochemical distinctions between apoptosis (immunologically silent) and lytic necrotic cell death

subtopic: Macroautophagy: molecular machinery, regulation and organelle clearance
key_concepts: Autophagy initiation: nutrient sensing by mTORC1 (inhibitor) and AMPK (activator), ULK1/Atg1 complex activation
Phagophore nucleation and expansion: Class III PI3K (Vps34-Beclin-1) complex, PI3P generation, WIPI recruitment
Ubiquitin-like conjugation cascades: Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 system and LC3-I to phosphatidylethanolamine-conjugated LC3-II (Atg8)
Autophagosome maturation, SNARE-mediated fusion with lysosomes (autolysosome), and selective autophagy (mitophagy, p62/SQSTM1)

subtopic: Concept of metaorganisms, holobiont biology and host-microbiome co-evolution
key_concepts: Definition of metaorganism and holobiont: host multicellular organism plus its symbiotic microbial communities
The hologenome theory of evolution: holobiont as a unit of selection, genetic variation via microbiome plasticity
Symbiosis modalities: mutualism, commensalism, pathobionts; colonization resistance against opportunistic pathogens
Co-speciation and phylosymbiosis: congruence between host phylogenetic trees and microbiome community dendrograms

subtopic: Mammalian gut microbiome composition, biogeography and profiling methods
key_concepts: Dominant taxonomic phyla in human gut: Bacillota (Firmicutes), Bacteroidota (Bacteroidetes), Actinomycetota, Pseudomonadota
Spatial biogeography along the gastrointestinal tract: stomach, small intestine (duodenum, ileum) to colon gradient
Molecular profiling approaches: 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing (hypervariable regions V3-V4) vs shotgun metagenomics
Diversity metrics: alpha diversity (Shannon, Simpson, Chao1) and beta diversity (Bray-Curtis dissimilarity, UniFrac)

subtopic: Germ-free and gnotobiotic animal models in physiological research
key_concepts: Generation and maintenance of germ-free (axenic) rodents in sterile isolator facilities
Physiological hallmarks of germ-free animals: cecal enlargement, hypoplastic Peyer's patches, altered cardiac output and metabolic rate
Gnotobiotic colonization: defined microbial consortia (e.g., Altered Schaedler Flora ASF) and humanized microbiota mice
Fecal Microbiota Transplantation (FMT) protocols to establish causal relationships in host disease phenotypes

subtopic: Microbial metabolites as physiological signaling molecules
key_concepts: Short-Chain Fatty Acids (SCFAs): acetate, propionate, butyrate fermentation from non-digestible dietary polysaccharides
SCFA GPCR signaling: FFAR2 (GPR43) and FFAR3 (GPR41) in colonocytes, immune cells, and endocrine cells
Epigenetic regulation: Butyrate and propionate acting as histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitors promoting Treg differentiation
Bile acid biotransformation: primary bile acids to secondary bile acids (deoxycholic, lithocholic acids) activating FXR and TGR5

subtopic: The gut-brain axis: neuroendocrine, immune and vagal pathways
key_concepts: Bidirectional communication routes: vagus nerve afferents, systemic neuroendocrine circulation, immune mediators
Enteric Nervous System (ENS) structure: myenteric (Auerbach) and submucosal (Meissner) plexuses
Microbial regulation of neurotransmitter production: gut enterochromaffin cell synthesis of serotonin (5-HT), GABA
Microbiome influence on microglial maturation, blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity, and neuroinflammation

subtopic: Gut barrier integrity, dysbiosis and systemic inflammation
key_concepts: Intestinal mucosal barrier components: mucin layers (MUC2), antimicrobial peptides (defensins, RegIII$\gamma$), secretory IgA
Tight junction complex architecture: occludin, claudins, zonula occludens (ZO-1), and regulation by zonulin
Dysbiosis definition: loss of diversity, loss of beneficial taxa, pathobiont blooming (e.g., Enterobacteriaceae)
Metabolic endotoxemia: LPS translocation through compromised gut barrier triggering systemic TLR4-NF-$\kappa$B inflammation

subtopic: Interorgan communication: the adipose-liver-skeletal muscle axis
key_concepts: White adipose tissue as an active endocrine organ: secretion of adiponectin, leptin, resistin, and inflammatory cytokines (TNF-$\alpha$, IL-6)
Liver-muscle metabolic cross-talk: Cori cycle, glucose-alanine cycle, and regulation of hepatic gluconeogenesis
Myokines produced by contracting skeletal muscle: Irisin, IL-6, myostatin; effects on browning of white adipose tissue
Hepatokines (Fetuin-A, FGF21) modulating peripheral insulin sensitivity and lipid storage

subtopic: Central and peripheral regulation of appetite and energy expenditure
key_concepts: Hypothalamic arcuate nucleus (ARC) neuronal circuitry: orexigenic (NPY/AgRP) vs anorexigenic (POMC/CART) neurons
Leptin receptor signaling (JAK2-STAT3) in hypothalamus: suppression of appetite and stimulation of energy expenditure
Gut satiety peptides: Ghrelin (stomach hunger signal), Cholecystokinin (CCK), Peptide YY (PYY), Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1)
Melanocortin system: $\alpha$-MSH agonism and AgRP inverse agonism at melanocortin 4 receptors (MC4R)

subtopic: Pathophysiology of insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome
key_concepts: Molecular insulin signaling: IRS1/2 phosphorylation, PI3K-Akt pathway, and GLUT4 glucose transporter translocation
Mechanisms of insulin resistance: serine phosphorylation of IRS1 (by JNK, IKK$\beta$, PKC$\theta$), lipotoxicity from diacylglycerols (DAG) and ceramides
Diagnostic criteria for Metabolic Syndrome: central obesity, elevated triglycerides, reduced HDL, hypertension, fasting hyperglycemia
Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) progression: simple steatosis to Non-Alcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) and cirrhosis

subtopic: Adipose tissue remodeling, thermogenesis and metabolic health
key_concepts: Adipose tissue types: white adipose tissue (WAT, energy storage) vs brown adipose tissue (BAT, non-shivering thermogenesis)
Uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) mechanism in brown adipocyte mitochondria: dissipating proton gradient as heat
Browning/beiging of white adipose tissue: beige/brite adipocyte induction by $\beta_3$-adrenergic stimulation and cold exposure
Adipocyte hypertrophy vs hyperplasia, hypoxia in expanding adipose tissue, crown-like macrophage infiltration

subtopic: Anthropogenic land-use change, habitat fragmentation and landscape connectivity
key_concepts: Landscape ecology metrics: patch size, patch shape complexity, core area, isolation distance, edge-to-area ratio
Ecological edge effects: microclimate alterations (temperature, wind, light penetration), predator encroachment, nest parasitism
Structural vs functional landscape connectivity, wildlife corridors, stepping-stone habitats, percolation theory
Relaxation fauna and species-area relationship ($S = c A^z$) applied to fragmented terrestrial habitat islands

subtopic: Climate change ecology, phenological shifts and species range contractions
key_concepts: Ecological fingerprints of climate change: poleward and elevational species range contractions
Phenological mismatches / trophic asynchrony (e.g., mismatch between peak caterpillar emergence and passerine nesting)
Marine climate impacts: ocean warming, thermal stratification, ocean acidification (pH reduction, aragonite undersaturation)
Thermal tolerance performance curves: critical thermal limits ($CT_{\max}$, $CT_{\min}$), thermal safety margins

subtopic: Ecotoxicology, environmental pollutants and bioaccumulation dynamics
key_concepts: Bioconcentration (BCF), bioaccumulation (BAF), and biomagnification across trophic food web levels
Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs: DDT, PCBs, dioxins) and organometallics (methylmercury)
Endocrine-Disrupting Chemicals (EDCs: bisphenols, phthalates) and reproductive impairment in wildlife
Emerging environmental contaminants: microplastics, nanoplastics, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)

subtopic: Biological invasion ecology and invasive species impact
key_concepts: Stages of biological invasion: transport, introduction, establishment, spread, integration
Hypotheses explaining invasion success: enemy release hypothesis, novel weapons hypothesis, fluctuating resource availability
Life history traits characteristic of successful invasive alien species: high fecundity, wide ecological tolerance, rapid growth
Ecological impacts of invasive species: displacement of native fauna/flora, alteration of fire regimes, trophic cascade disruption

subtopic: The Biological Diversity Act 2002 of India: governance and institutions
key_concepts: Three-tier administrative infrastructure: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA), State Biodiversity Boards (SBB), Biodiversity Management Committees (BMC)
Mandate and functions of NBA: approvals for foreign access to biological resources and commercial IP patent filings
Declaration and protection of Biodiversity Heritage Sites (BHS) under Section 37 of the Act
Offenses, penalties, and exemptions under the Biological Diversity Act 2002 and Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act

subtopic: People's Biodiversity Registers (PBR) and Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS)
key_concepts: Preparation, verification, and digitization of People's Biodiversity Registers (PBR) at local panchayat levels
Documentation of traditional ecological knowledge (TEK), local agro-biodiversity, and medicinal bioresources
Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) mechanisms under the Nagoya Protocol framework and NBA guidelines
Fair and equitable sharing of monetary and non-monetary benefits arising from bioresource utilization

subtopic: Agrobiodiversity conservation, crop wild relatives and on-farm preservation
key_concepts: Agrobiodiversity components: crop genetic diversity, livestock breeds, beneficial soil microbiota, pollinator assemblages
Crop Wild Relatives (CWR) as reservoirs of abiotic stress and disease resistance alleles
Genetic erosion causes: replacement of landraces by monoculture high-yielding varieties, agricultural intensification
In situ on-farm conservation strategies and participatory plant breeding (PPB) with local farming communities

subtopic: International treaties: PGRFA, CBD and global genetic resource governance
key_concepts: International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA, FAO Seed Treaty)
The Multilateral System (MLS) of access and benefit sharing covering Annex 1 food and forage crops
Standard Material Transfer Agreement (SMTA) terms and global Benefit-sharing Fund operation
Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) principles: national sovereignty over biological resources vs common heritage

subtopic: The PPVFR Act 2001: farmers' rights, breeders' rights and DUS testing
key_concepts: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights (PPVFR) Act 2001 of India: unique dual protection model
Criteria for plant variety registration: Distinctiveness, Uniformity, and Stability (DUS testing)
Categories of registrable varieties: new varieties, extant varieties, essentially derived varieties (EDV), farmers' varieties
Farmer rights under PPVFR: right to save, use, sow, resow, exchange, and sell farm seed; National Gene Fund

subtopic: Ex situ conservation strategies: seed gene banks and cryopreservation
key_concepts: Physiological classification of seeds: orthodox (desiccation-tolerant), intermediate, and recalcitrant (desiccation-sensitive)
Optimal storage conditions for orthodox seed banks: drying to 3–7% moisture content and cooling to $-18^\circ\text{C}$ to $-20^\circ\text{C}$
Cryopreservation protocols for clonal crops and recalcitrant seeds in liquid nitrogen ($-196^\circ\text{C}$): vitrification, encapsulation-dehydration
Global germplasm repositories: National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR, India) and Svalbard Global Seed Vault

subtopic: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) technologies and chemistry
key_concepts: Single-cell isolation platforms: microfluidic droplet encapsulation (10x Genomics Chromium, inDrop), microwells (Seq-Well), FACS sorting
Barcoding chemistry: Cell Barcodes (CBC) for cell deconvolution and Unique Molecular Identifiers (UMI) to eliminate PCR amplification bias
Plate-based full-length transcript sequencing (Smart-seq2/3) vs droplet-based 3'/5' end counting
Quality metrics: sequencing depth, fraction of mitochondrial reads, doublets detection (Scrublet, DoubletFinder)

subtopic: scRNA-seq computational data analysis and cell clustering
key_concepts: Data normalization methods: LogNormalize, SCTransform (regularized negative binomial regression), variance stabilizing transformation
Feature selection of Highly Variable Genes (HVGs) and dimensionality reduction via Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
Non-linear visualization algorithms: t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) vs Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP)
Graph-based clustering (Louvain, Leiden algorithms) and cell type marker identification via differential expression

subtopic: Single-cell epigenomics and multimodal single-cell omics
key_concepts: Single-cell ATAC-seq (scATAC-seq): hyperactive Tn5 transposase tagging accessible open chromatin in single nuclei
CITE-seq (Cellular Indexing of Transcriptomes and Epitopes): oligo-conjugated antibodies for concurrent cell surface proteomics and RNA-seq
Single-cell DNA methylation sequencing (scBS-seq) and single-cell whole-genome sequencing (scWGS)
Multimodal integration algorithms: Seurat Weighted Nearest Neighbor (WNN) analysis across paired transcriptomic-epigenomic data

subtopic: Pseudotime lineage trajectory and RNA velocity analysis
key_concepts: Lineage reconstruction and developmental trajectory inference: minimum spanning trees and principal curves (Monocle, Slingshot)
RNA velocity principle: measuring ratio of unspliced (nascent) to spliced (mature) pre-mRNAs to predict future cellular state
Dynamical vs steady-state RNA velocity models (velocyto, scVelo)
Cell fate transition probability, branching points, and terminal differentiation attractor identification

subtopic: Spatial transcriptomics and in situ spatial sequencing methods
key_concepts: Array-based spatial capture: spatially barcoded capture spots (10x Visium, Slide-seq, HDST) and histological image registration
In situ hybridization-based imaging methods: Multiplexed Error-Robust FISH (MERFISH) and sequential FISH (seqFISH)
In situ sequencing approaches (ISS, FISSEQ) and subcellular spatial resolution limits
Computational deconvolution of spatial capture spots using single-cell reference atlases (RCTD, Cell2location)

subtopic: Metabolomics: analytical instrumentation and targeted profiling
key_concepts: Metabolite extraction workflows: quench protocols, biphasic liquid-liquid extraction (Bligh-Dyer, Matyash)
Targeted metabolomics by Liquid Chromatography-Tandem Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) using Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM)
Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS): chemical derivatization (methoximation, silylation with MSTFA/BSTFA) of non-volatile metabolites
Ion sources and analyzers: Electrospray Ionization (ESI), Atmospheric Pressure Chemical Ionization (APCI), triple quadrupole (QqQ)

subtopic: Untargeted metabolomics, high-resolution MS and fluxomics
key_concepts: High-Resolution Mass Spectrometry (HRMS) platforms: Q-TOF and Orbitrap analyzers providing sub-ppm mass accuracy
Metabolite annotation confidence levels (MSI guidelines Levels 1–4): accurate $m/z$, isotopic pattern, MS/MS fragmentation matching
Spectral databases and bioinformatic pipelines: METLIN, HMDB, MassBank, GNPS molecular networking, XCMS
Stable isotope-assisted metabolomics and $^{13}\text{C}$-Metabolic Flux Analysis ($^{13}\text{C}$-MFA) to quantify intracellular pathway fluxes

subtopic: Intellectual property rights (IPR) and biological patenting
key_concepts: Forms of Intellectual Property: Patents, Trademarks, Copyrights, Trade Secrets, Plant Variety Protection, Geographical Indications (GI)
Criteria for patentability of biological inventions: Novelty (global prior art), Inventive step (non-obviousness), Industrial applicability
Patentable vs non-patentable subject matter in biotechnology: Section 3 of Indian Patents Act (Section 3(c), 3(d), 3(h), 3(i), 3(j))
Deposit of biological materials under the Budapest Treaty at International Depository Authorities (IDA)

subtopic: Patent specifications, patent databases and international filing procedures
key_concepts: Anatomy of a patent document: provisional vs complete specification, drawings, independent and dependent claims
International patent filing routes: Paris Convention (12-month priority window) vs Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT, 30/31-month national phase)
Patent search databases and prior art searching: USPTO, EPO Espacenet, WIPO Patentscope, InPASS (Indian Patent Office)
Patent claim interpretation, Freedom to Operate (FTO) analysis, and patent infringement types (literal vs doctrine of equivalents)

subtopic: Biosafety levels, bioethics, animal welfare and AI ethics in research
key_concepts: Biosafety Levels: BSL-1, BSL-2, BSL-3, and BSL-4 facility engineering, containment, and PPE criteria for biohazards
Recombinant DNA safety regulatory bodies in India: IBSC, Review Committee on Genetic Manipulation (RCGM), Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee (GEAC)
Bioethics and animal welfare in animal research: CPCSEA/CCSEA guidelines, 3Rs principle (Replacement, Reduction, Refinement), IAEC approval
Research ethics and AI in scientific publishing: publication integrity, Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE), plagiarism detection, responsible AI attribution
